{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained positive sentiment (e.g., >0.5) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% when recent true outcomes show sharp downward corrections after model spikes.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 10-15% unless sentiment supports continuation.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment shifts: if sentiment turns negative (e.g., <0.0), reduce forecast by 5-10% to reflect risk.",
    "Cap forecast growth after 3 consecutive days of upward sentiment to avoid over-optimism.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below 30-day forecast, apply a downward bias of 5-8% for next period.",
    "For long-term (30d) forecasts, reduce forecast by 3-5% if sentiment history shows no recent positive momentum."
  ]
}
